title: ACS 5-year source mapping
notes: Each variable is a source-independent statistical variable. The ACS cells here are how this release is computed, never the public id.
A cell is TABLE_NNN (for example B01003_001). The estimate is the E column and the margin of error is the M column of that cell in the Census table-based summary file.
calculation.type: direct = one cell; sum = add cells (and optionally subtract others); share = a numerator over the denominator variable, as percent.
Margins: a sum or difference uses the square root of the sum of squared margins. A share uses the Census proportion formula, and the ratio formula when that has a negative root.

openEnded: a median the Census publishes as 'or more' (margin code -333333333, estimate cap + 1). It is written as a one-sided bound (minValue = cap) with no value and no margin of error, and only when the source estimate is exactly cap + 1.
role: indicator is a measure for people to read. denominator is published so a share can be reproduced and is the measurementDenominator of its share.
